## Claiming Claim2Core work

1. Find the parent issue in the #141 implementation sequence.
2. Comment with the exact sub-scope you want to own.
3. Keep the change small enough to review independently.
4. Maintainers assign the issue once scope is clear.
5. Link the parent issue from the PR.

Use `good first issue` only when a newcomer can complete the task without understanding or modifying the sched_ext/BPF hot path.
